posts.title: Where we’re going, we won’t need algorithms
posts.description: I'm old enough to remember driving without maps or navigation. Soon, we won't remember a time before AI coding either. Does driving without maps make me a better driver now? I don't think so. Does knowing how to code without AI help make me a better engineer? It does... for now.
